# Yordan Hristov — Senior Product Designer

> I build AI-ready design systems with 1:1 code parity and architect the AI workflows that connect product, design, and engineering. Working alongside Technical Product Managers and developers, I help eliminate the traditional handoff by designing systems, optimising processes, and contributing directly to PRDs, prototypes, and production code.

## Profile

- Location: Sofia, Bulgaria

I build AI-ready design systems: component libraries with 1:1 parity between Figma and code, plus custom Claude skills and MCP setups that let agents assemble UI from the real system without drift. I write and ship the frontend myself, reviewed and merged by engineering. Under the tooling sits seven years of research practice — user interviews, usability testing, and WCAG 2.1 AA auditing.

## Experience

### Senior Product Designer — Green Street (commercial real estate data and analytics)

Jan 2026 – Present · Sofia · Hybrid

- Redesigned the AI Assistant module and built its design system end to end: a Figma library at 1:1 parity with the coded components (~35 and growing), tokens implemented directly in the frontend component library replacing every hardcoded value for 100% token coverage, and a living style guide used for visual testing and design-to-code comparison.
- Wrote custom Claude skills that let AI agents assemble UI from the real design system without drift. The TPM team uses them to generate interactive prototypes.
- Wrote and shipped the responsive navigation for the Analytics platform — reviewed and merged by engineering, live in production.
- Audited Green Street News and the Analytics & Research Platform against WCAG 2.1 AA and UX heuristics: 200+ issue instances catalogued with severity ratings and a prioritised remediation roadmap.
- Building a design-to-code pipeline that generates frontend pages from Figma with AI assistance. The internal version is under NDA; the open-source system above is the same architecture, public.

### Senior Product Designer — Studio Kipo (sole designer for all client work)

2023 – Dec 2025 · Sofia · Remote

- Introduced design systems as studio practice. No client asked for one — I built a white-label token-based system and reused it across projects, cutting setup time on every new brief and giving developers one source for spacing, colour, and type.
- Ubistats Football — analytics platform taken from research through design system, UI, and usability testing. Led to a partnership with the Bulgarian Football Union.
- Spetema — a 200+ product coffee catalogue serving households and businesses from one site. Split navigation into home and business tracks, layered a preparation-method finder over the category taxonomy, and structured eight sub-brands on a shared attribute model. Bilingual, live.
- Mindromeda — mental health marketplace connecting people to licensed therapists and coaches. Full design and IA: specialist matching by need, session booking, and consumer access alongside corporate vouchers. Live on Google Play.
- Malko Tarnovo Municipal App — semantic colour tokens and a dual visual language serving tourists and older residents at once. Live on the App Store and Google Play.
- Also: the USD bank account feature for Tax Advice, a cross-border tax refund service, designed end to end from proposition to launch; Go Guide, the first mobile app for Bulgaria's leading lifestyle media brand; and an internal order management UI for a top US auto parts distributor.

### UX Researcher & Consultant — Domestina (Bulgaria's leading cleaning services marketplace)

2019 – Present · advisory since 2022 · Sofia

- Rebuilt the front page and the critical booking flows after heuristic evaluation, user interviews, and Hotjar session analysis. Bounce rate dropped 40% and sessions ran longer.
- Shaped research-driven features including the Domestina Club loyalty programme and a rebuilt registration flow, supporting retention and the move beyond the local market.
- Still consulting on research and flow decisions.

### Product Designer & Frontend — Independent

2018 – Present · Remote

- NFT and crypto: launched solo and collaborative projects covering digital art, community mechanics, and gamification. Creative coding in p5.js and Three.js sold as digital art; market and competitor research produced profitable collections during a bear market.
- Design, frontend implementation, and QA for portfolio and small-business sites, working in a small team.

### Service Designer & Team Lead — Live to Lift

2009 – 2020 · Sofia

- Managed a team of 5–6 coaches. Designed the recruitment programme and trained every new hire into it.
- Built the assessment and interview framework the whole practice ran on: hundreds of client interviews, structured progress measurement, outcome tracking.
- Ran client surveys, analysed outcome and business data, and owned the online presence and camp programme.

### Quality Assurance Expert — CNCsys PLC (manufacturing software QA, first technical role)
